Decision-making methods for Rätselhaft!

  1. One corpus. Several viable ways.
  2. Dark: current selection
  3. How do others find the relevant collection?
  4. Curated inventory with entry
  5. Adult workstation
  6. Task: to make relevant data, rules and entry visible
  7. How does the local investigation begin?
  8. Versioned complete downloads
  9. Only via the running server
  10. Task: Provide data independently of server and team
  11. Which version is being examined?
  12. Verified release + archive
  13. Exact Committance
  14. Current main
  15. Task: Identifying data, selection and procedures intelligible
  16. What is the commitment after the sponsor?
  17. Actively Maintain
  18. Preserving
  19. Transfer
  20. Completed
  21. Together: Get understandable data and make commitment visible
  22. All ways: tested releases, understandable documentation and tested handover.
  23. Change requires re-examination; different ways mean different work.
Decision paths and data flows as text

Sources and internal research lead through an early publication concept for examination and curation. The public repo provides released data, rules and examples. Releases are archived independently. Researchers work locally with designated versions and report back corrections or new annotations; their adoption requires testing and maintenance capacity again.
